content.summary: Zuora Inc (ZUO) has disclosed a new risk, in the Corporate Activity and Growth category. Zuora Inc. faces a significant risk concerning its proposed merger, as stockholders will receive a fixed cash payment of $10.00 per share, excluding any further equity participation. Consequently, if the company’s business thrives post-merger, current stockholders will not benefit from the company’s enhanced performance, as they will not hold any equity interests in the parent company.
